mods.name: No Plains
mods.description: Removes plains biomes from world generation: plains and sunflower plains become forest, snowy plains becomes snowy taiga.

releases.notes:
First release of No Plains for Minecraft 26.3.

Plains and sunflower plains are replaced with forest, snowy plains with
snowy taiga, so snowy regions stay snowy.

Only affects chunks generated after installing the mod. Chunks that already
exist keep their biomes, so an existing world will show a visible seam where
the old terrain ends. Start a new world for a consistent result.

**Requires:** Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API 0.160.5+26.3, Java 25

readmeSummary: A small Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 that removes plains biomes from world generation.
